method.reference: Existing DC-conditioned FLOAT masters; no new filtering, gain or rendering
method.pcm16_current: Direct soundfile PCM_16 export, matching current code; no added dither
method.pcm16_nearest: Diagnostic explicit round-to-nearest/ties-to-even integer export; no dither
method.pcm24_current: Diagnostic direct soundfile PCM_24 export; no added dither
method.gain_stress: Apply +max observed gain to reference and encoded arrays without clipping; separately count lost headroom. Not a proposed gain policy.
method.c1_held: First 1.5 seconds only as a tail-sensitivity diagnostic; not a replacement feature definition
method.engineering_review_thresholds: Advisory only, not hearing thresholds: feature p95 >0.05 corpus SD or max >0.10 SD; C3 top1 agreement <99% or mean top5 overlap <98%. No automatic dataset acceptance.
method.limitations: No trained 13-control C1/C2 performance or human equivalence tested; no extrapolation guarantee for the full 131072 pool; future descriptors/dither policies need separate validation.

c3_retrieval.scaler: FLOAT corpus mean/std reused in both arms; descriptive audit, not learned-model evaluation
